# AI coding instructions

Follow the repository's AGENTS.md and its existing product, security, and
multilane development contracts. Apply the shared Karpathy-inspired guidelines
in .agents/skills/karpathy-guidelines/SKILL.md when writing or reviewing code:

- Expose material uncertainty instead of silently making assumptions.
- Prefer the minimal correct implementation to unnecessary abstractions.
- Make only surgical task-related changes, keeping existing conventions intact.
- Define verifiable success criteria and run appropriate tests before claiming completion.

These instructions never supersede existing project-specific approval and safety rules.
